title: ISO 1328-1:2013 — Cylindrical gears — ISO system of flank tolerance classification — Part 1
locator: Official catalogue abstract: definitions and allowable values for flank deviations of individual cylindrical involute gears; reviewed and confirmed 2024
notes: Applies to individual cylindrical involute gear tooth flanks. It must not be applied automatically to cylindrical worm flank deviations or the assembled rotary table. Worm-specific ISO/DIS 1328-4 remains a draft at the access date. Full text is not archived.
